errors.text_span: 所有切片均按面积大小从大到小顺时针排列
errors.evidence: The description claims that the slices are arranged clockwise in descending order of size, but this is not true. Starting from the largest slice (社会常识, 47.23%) and moving clockwise, the next slice is 物理常识 (8.02%), which is the smallest slice, not the second largest.
